description: Prepare a 15-minute reviewed restore of a completed backup's managed PostgreSQL or MariaDB dump into a NEW database on the original or an eligible target binding's provider of the same engine — the current database is never overwritten and nothing is cut over. Returns the review with source, target database and digest; preparing queues nothing. The binding must be healthy: a pending credential rotation or cleanup refuses the review. Requires deploy scope.

backup_id.description: The completed backup to restore, from impreza_list_backups.

target_binding_id.description: Optional. Restore through a different managed connection of the account (its provider, its owner) — the migration shape. Omit to use the connection the backup came from.

name: impreza_prepare_database_restore
title: Review database restore
